interpretation_limit: Identifies the credit scoring model/type, not the applicant's numerical credit score or creditworthiness.
Property value measures collateral value, not savings, liquid assets, or financial reserves.
AUS fields identify automated underwriting systems used, not the actual recommendation or underwriting decision.
Activity year provides annual information but not the exact application date or within-year timing.
Reported income and DTI do not capture employment stability, verification quality, or the documents used by underwriters.
Submission channel and lender fixed effects cannot identify individual loan officers or their decisions.
